statement: On the ARC-AGI-1 training split the grid program search without its fallback phase (the control arm) solved 144 of 400 tasks (36 percent) with one attempt per task, no model and a 3000 ms wall clock budget per task, mean 1894.02 ms per task. 0 exhausted the vocabulary, 241 ran out of clock, 15 found a program that fit every train pair and missed a test output. Every solved answer is what a chain of grid.dsl cells emitted after grid.dsl.match cells confirmed every train pair. This is the TRAINING split, which the vocabulary was written against, so it is not comparable to the published row; the published no-model row is Icecuber (Kaggle, program search over a hand written DSL, no LLM) at 17 percent on the evaluation split. Contaminated: the training split is the one the vocabulary was written against, so this run is in sample. This file is not the bar: the training split is in sample (the vocabulary was written against it), so no published row is a bar for it; the ARC bar is on the evaluation split; a control arm (--fixed-vocab): the search without the fallback phase.
